concept: WAF: SQLi/XSS protection and L7 rate-based rules
tests: Choosing a service to protect a web app from SQL injection, XSS and L7 floods in front of CloudFront.
expected: AWS WAF on CloudFront with managed rule groups (SQLi, XSS) and rate-based rules. Triggers: "SQL injection", "cross-site scripting", "rate-based", "layer-7 attacks".
why_not: GuardDuty detects threats but doesn't filter requests; Shield Standard — L3/L4 DDoS, not application exploits; security groups — L3/L4.
